title: One Point Lesson - PSV-5607 Testing & Car-Seal Management (OPL-EA-5601-07)
content:
ONE POINT LESSON (OPL): OPL-EA-5601-07 - PSV-5607 Testing & Car-Seal Management.

Equipment: EA-5601 (SOLVENT HEATER), Discipline: Mechanical, Area: 5600 - SOLVENT HEATING SYSTEM.

Related Interlock: N/A (control loop only), P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-5601.

PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:
This One Point Lesson explains psv-5607 testing & car-seal management for EA-5601 (SOLVENT HEATER) in the SOLVENT HEATING SYSTEM. The tube-side relief valve is the exchanger's overpressure protection and must be proven and never isolated in service. The lesson gives operators and technicians the key knowledge and the correct step-by-step method so the task is done safely, correctly and consistently every time.

SAFETY PRECAUTIONS:
- Precaution 1: Apply LOTO (Lock-Out Tag-Out) and prove zero energy before starting work.
- Precaution 2: Isolate, depressurise, drain and purge the equipment; obtain a valid work permit.
- Precaution 3: Wear the correct PPE: coverall, safety shoes, gloves, goggles and hearing protection.
- Precaution 4: Beware of stored mechanical energy (springs, rotating inertia) and pinch points.
- Precaution 5: Use certified lifting gear and correct manual-handling technique for heavy parts.

TOOLS & MATERIALS:
- Tool 1: Standard mechanical hand tools & calibrated torque wrench
- Tool 2: LOTO padlocks and permit
- Tool 3: Laser/dial alignment kit (as applicable)
- Tool 4: Feeler gauges, dial indicator, seal/bearing pullers
- Tool 5: Correct spare parts and gaskets per the BOM
- Tool 6: Lifting gear and slings (certified)

STEP-BY-STEP PROCEDURE:
- Step 1 - Action: Confirm PSV-5607 is set to 16 barg on the nameplate
- Step 1 - Check: Isolation & LOTO verified
- Step 2 - Action: Carry out an off-line pop test per the statutory schedule
- Step 2 - Check: Parts match BOM / spec
- Step 3 - Action: Keep the PSV inlet/outlet isolation car-sealed open in service
- Step 3 - Check: Torque / clearance to spec
- Step 4 - Action: Record the test certificate and next due date
- Step 4 - Check: No leak / smooth operation
- Step 5 - Action: Never block-in a live PSV without an authorised spare
- Step 5 - Check: Record in equipment history

COMMON PROBLEMS & TROUBLESHOOTING:
- Symptom: High tube dP PDT-5605, low solvent outlet temperature | Likely Cause: Hexane fouling / polymer fines deposit on tube bores | Action: Hydrojetted 246 tubes, restored dP and duty, re-gasketed
- Symptom: Hexane weep at channel flange | Likely Cause: Spiral-wound channel gasket relaxed / damaged | Action: Renewed channel gasket, re-torqued in cross pattern
- Symptom: Continuous steam at condensate, high steam use | Likely Cause: Steam trap element failed open | Action: Replaced steam trap element, verified condensate temperature

KEY LEARNING POINTS:
- Point 1: The tube-side relief valve is the exchanger's overpressure protection and must be proven and never isolated in service.
- Point 2: Always cross-check the Datasheet limits and the P&ID TJC-LLD-PID-5601 before working on EA-5601.
- Point 3: Record the work in the equipment history so the Knowledge Hub stays the single source of truth.
